description: Winter Storm Severity Index (NOAA WSSI) — How disruptive winter weather will be at a US point over the next 3 days, from the NOAA WPC Winter Storm Severity Index: overall impact NONE / WINTER WEATHER AREA / MINOR / MODERATE / MAJOR / EXTREME for days 1-3 combined and for each day (valid times UTC), what that level means for daily life and travel, and which components drive it (snow amount, snow load, ice accumulation, blowing snow). Params: lat, lon (decimal degrees, contiguous US). For logistics, school/closure planning and travel agents. Public-domain US government data. JSON. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_winter_severity
